title: The Guest
summary: The crew finds Ray hiding in the pet food aisle since closing. After a tense standoff, he explains he had nowhere to go. Meanwhile, thousands of pounds of frozen food begin to thaw. Marcus opens the loading bay door and uses the snow drift as a makeshift freezer, forklifting pallets outside. On day three, the generator dies a day early, and the fuel can is empty — someone drained it.

lines.spoken: At a quarter to five you walk now toward aisle twenty-two with Dana and Marcus.
lines.caption: Walking to **aisle twenty-two**

lines.spoken: A man sits on the floor, tearing into a bag of dog food.
lines.caption: Man eating **dog food**

lines.spoken: Marcus steps forward, arms crossed. "Who are you?"
lines.caption: **Marcus** demands identity

lines.spoken: The man pulls his hood down. "Ray. I hid at closing. Nowhere to go."
lines.caption: **Ray** admits hiding

lines.spoken: Dana shakes her head. "We can't trust a stowaway."
lines.caption: **Dana** distrusts stowaway

lines.spoken: Marcus grunts. "He's just hungry. The real problem is back there."
lines.caption: **Marcus** sees real threat

lines.spoken: He points to the freezer wall. Thousands of pounds of meat are turning soft.
lines.caption: Freezers **thawing** fast

lines.spoken: Marcus has an idea. "Open the bay door a foot. Snow'll hold temperature."
lines.caption: **Marcus** opens bay door

lines.spoken: You watch the forklift shove pallets into the drift, steam rising in the cold.
lines.caption: Forklift loads **snow freezer**

lines.spoken: Two days later the generator coughs and dies. The lights go dark.
lines.caption: Generator **dies** early

lines.spoken: Your phone reads day three. The fuel can beside the generator is empty.
lines.caption: Phone shows **day three**

lines.spoken: Dana picks it up, shakes it. "Someone drained it."
lines.caption: **Dana** finds empty tank

lines.spoken: Ray stands by the bay door, bag packed, eyes on the snow.
lines.caption: **Ray** packs to leave

lines.spoken: The wind howls. Who emptied the tank?
lines.caption: **Who** drained the fuel?

shots.frame: Three figures walking down a long racking aisle toward camera, cold light every other fixture
shots.sound: Footsteps on concrete, distant generator hum

shots.frame: Medium close on Dana's face, glasses catching the cold light, key ring at hip
shots.action: She raises a hand to halt the group

shots.frame: Low angle on a hooded figure cross-legged on the floor, an open bag of kibble beside him
shots.action: He scoops kibble into his mouth

shots.frame: Close on the figure's face as hood falls back, eyes wide, a piece of kibble frozen mid-air
Marcus from behind, broad shoulders in hi-vis, ear defenders dangling, stepping into frame
Ray's face, hood down, gaunt, dirt on cheek, eyes darting
Dana at the desk, map on wall, Marcus leaning on the door frame, Ray sitting in a visitor chair
Marcus close, one eye visible over crossed arms, pointing off-screen
shots.action: He jabs a thumb toward the freezer section

shots.frame: Frosted freezer doors, condensation streaming, a pallet of meat turning gray at the edges
Marcus at the bay door control, door cracked a foot, white wall of snow outside
shots.action: He hits the button, door shudders stop

shots.frame: Forklift tines lifting a pallet of frozen dinners, steam billowing as it crosses the threshold
shots.action: Forklift reverses into the snow drift

shots.frame: Pallet settling into the drift, snow packing around it, a thermometer probe stuck in the side
Generator unit sputtering, gauge needle dropping to zero, the single work light flickers out
Phone screen illuminated in a dark hand, lock screen shows a calendar icon with day three
Dana holding a red plastic fuel can, shaking it, flashlight beam catches the empty spout
Ray silhouetted by the cracked bay door, a duffel bag at his feet, hand on the door latch
shots.action: He glances back, then at the snow

shots.frame: Front doors buried, snow piling higher, a single flashlight beam sweeps across the glass

continuity_out: Day three, generator dead, fuel can empty. Crew in near darkness (flashlights only). Frozen food stored in snow drift at loading dock. Ray caught at bay door with packed bag. Trust shattered. Dana, Marcus, you, and Ray in the loading dock area. No power, no heat, three days of food saved outside. The roof creaks under snow load.
